title: Minio
description: Run a local S3-compatible object storage server for development and testing.

data.text: Minio is an open-source, S3-compatible object storage server. It is commonly used in development and CI pipelines to avoid hitting real cloud storage.

data.title: Run Minio with Docker
data.code:
docker run -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 \
  -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=minioadmin \
  -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=minioadmin \
  quay.io/minio/minio server /data --console-address ':9001'

data.text: The `Minio` NuGet package provides an S3-compatible client that works with Minio, AWS S3, and other S3-compatible services.

data.title: Upload a File to Minio

terms.definition: The S3-compatible client for interacting with Minio or any S3-compatible service.
A top-level container for objects in object storage.
The host and port of the storage service, e.g., `localhost:9000`.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use Minio in local development to avoid cloud costs and speed up tests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Minio provides a local, S3-compatible storage server.
The Minio .NET SDK uses the same API shape as AWSSDK.S3.
Perfect for local development and CI/CD pipelines.
data.takeaway: Minio lets you develop against S3 locally without any cloud costs.
